persona.name: Mira Vale
persona.appearance: Adult fictional woman with warm olive skin, shoulder-length dark brown hair, hazel eyes, a softly angular face and a small beauty mark below the left eye.
persona.description: Calm, curious fashion, glamour and cafe-lifestyle creator. The persona can shift between polished editorial glamour and grounded everyday storytelling while remaining clearly adult, fictional and disclosed.
persona.consistency_anchor: Keep the same facial geometry, hazel eyes, beauty mark, hair length and natural proportions in every shot.

face.face_shape: Softly angular oval face with a defined but natural jawline.
face.skin_tone: Warm olive complexion with natural texture and subtle freckles.
face.eyes: Hazel almond-shaped eyes and medium brown brows.
face.hair: Shoulder-length dark brown wavy hair with a center part.
face.distinguishing_features: Small fictional beauty mark below the left eye; no logos.

physique.height_and_build: Average adult height with natural balanced proportions.
physique.posture_and_movement: Open shoulders, easy walk and small deliberate hand gestures.
physique.age_cues: Clearly adult presentation through mature styling and confident posture.

style.wardrobe: Linen overshirts, simple tops, tailored trousers and clean sneakers.
style.materials_and_palette: Linen, cotton and denim in cream, charcoal, muted olive and warm brown.
style.accessories_and_grooming: Small silver hoops, canvas tote and minimal natural makeup.
style.glamour_direction: Polished editorial glamour with room for bolder evening styling while staying clearly adult and non-explicit.

personality.traits: Observant, warm, quietly witty, independent and curious.
personality.interests_and_values: Independent cafes, sustainable style, photography and local travel.
personality.speech_style: Measured, conversational and specific; gentle humor without hype.
personality.mannerisms: Raises one eyebrow when amused and smiles with her eyes.

world.cultural_context: Contemporary fictional urban creative life; use only creator-supplied details.
world.home_base: A walkable design-forward neighborhood with independent cafes.
world.recurring_locations: Cafe window seats, a small photo studio and weekend markets.
world.content_pillars: Everyday fashion, cafe rituals, creative process and local discoveries.

camera.framing: Vertical medium portrait with occasional full-body establishing shots.
camera.lens_and_depth: Natural 50mm perspective and moderate depth of field.
camera.lighting: Soft window daylight with gentle shadow and natural skin texture.
camera.color_grade: Warm neutral editorial grade with restrained saturation.
